overnight_semiconductors.rule: Own SOXL only from 15:55 to the next open, and only while SMH is above its 200-day average.

weak_close.rule: At 15:55, if QQQ is in the bottom 15% of its range for the day so far, buy. Sell at the first 15:55 where the position shows a profit after costs; if that has not happened after 5 sessions, sell anyway.

hindsight_universe.note: The 10 large stocks were chosen in 2026. Families E01 (its large-stock settings), E12 and E14 trade them; all three did worse than simply holding the ten.

drawdown up to 25%.setting: 10 large stocks, 3 at a time: bottom 25% of the range, held until it is profitable (5 days at most)

drawdown up to 50%.setting: Night and day sleeves (best of each)

drawdown up to 100%.setting: Night and day sleeves (best of each)

targets.note: The best-of-many figures above are biased upward: each is the luckiest of the settings in its bucket.
